RewriteOptions inherit

# Olimp: tutto su https://www.olimpitalia.com (301). Non tocca .well-known (rinnovo SSL)
# né i sottodomini mail., webmail., cpanel.
RewriteEngine On
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^(www\.)?olimpitalia\.com$ [NC]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/\.well-known/
RewriteCond %{HTTPS} off [OR]
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^olimpitalia\.com$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^ https://www.olimpitalia.com%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]

# php -- BEGIN cPanel-generated handler, do not edit
# Set the “ea-php81” package as the default “PHP” programming language.
<IfModule mime_module>
  AddHandler application/x-httpd-ea-php81___lsphp .php .php8 .phtml
</IfModule>
# php -- END cPanel-generated handler, do not edit
